pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
Last updated: 22 August 2026

This notice explains what personal information Rise & Flour collects when you use our website or get in touch with us, why we collect it, and what your rights are. We've tried to keep it short and in plain English. If anything is unclear, email us at contact@riseandflour.co.uk.

Who we are

Rise & Flour is the trading name of Rise and Flour Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales, which runs the café at The Elms, Shipton Road, Milton-under-Wychwood, Chipping Norton OX7 6JP. Rise and Flour Ltd is the "data controller" for the information described in this notice, which means we decide how and why it is used. You can reach us by email at contact@riseandflour.co.uk or by phone on 01993 831 856.

What this notice covers

It covers our website, riseandflour.co.uk, and the ways you contact us through it — the contact form, email and phone — including enquiries about events and private hire. It doesn't cover other websites we link to, such as Google Maps or social media; those have their own privacy notices.

What information we collect

Information you give us

When you use the contact form, email us, or call, we receive what you choose to tell us: usually your name, email address, the subject of your enquiry and your message. If you're booking a place at an event or asking about private hire, that may also include the date, the number of people, and anything you tell us about dietary needs or allergies so that we can cook around them.

We don't ask for, and don't want, any information beyond what's needed to answer you. Our website has no customer accounts, no logins, and no online shop, so we don't hold passwords or payment details.

Information collected automatically

Like almost every website, ours runs on a server that keeps standard logs: the IP address your device connects from, the pages requested, the date and time, and basic browser and device details. These logs exist to keep the site secure and working, and we don't use them to identify individual visitors.

We don't collect "special category" information (such as health, religion or ethnicity) — except that if you mention an allergy or dietary need in an enquiry, we'll use it only to respond to that enquiry.

How we use it, and our legal basis

Under UK data protection law we need a lawful reason for using your information. Ours are:

  • To reply to you and deal with your enquiry or booking — because you've asked us to, and because it's in both our interests to answer (our "legitimate interests", and where a booking is involved, taking steps towards an agreement with you).
  • To keep the website secure and working — our legitimate interest in running a safe, reliable site.
  • To meet our legal obligations — for example keeping records we're required to keep, or responding to a lawful request from an authority.

We don't use your information for marketing unless you've asked us to keep you posted, and we never sell it.

Cookies

Our website doesn't set any cookies of its own for visitors, and we don't use advertising trackers.

The map on our Location page is provided by Google Maps. When that page loads, Google may set its own cookies and collect information about your visit in line with Google's privacy policy. By using the map you're also bound by Google's Terms of Service. If you'd rather avoid that, simply don't open the Location page.

If we add visitor analytics in future, we'll update this notice and, where the law requires it, ask for your consent first.

Who we share it with

We don't sell or rent your information, and we don't share it with anyone for their own marketing. A small number of companies handle it on our behalf so that the website and our email work:

  • SiteGround — hosts the website, so the server logs and anything submitted through the site pass through their systems.
  • Microsoft 365 — runs our email. Messages sent through the contact form, and any emails you send us, are stored in our Microsoft mailbox.
  • Google — provides the embedded map, as described under Cookies.

Each of these is bound by contract to protect your information and to use it only to provide their service to us. Beyond that, we would only disclose personal information where the law requires it — for example to a regulator, a court, or the police.

Where it's stored

Our website is hosted in the UK and our email is held in Microsoft's UK/EU data centres. Some providers may process information elsewhere as part of running their service; where information leaves the UK, it's protected by safeguards recognised under UK law, such as the UK's adequacy regulations or the International Data Transfer Agreement.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiries and booking correspondence for as long as we need them to deal with your request, and for a reasonable time afterwards in case you come back to us — normally no longer than two years from our last contact. Records we're legally required to keep (such as anything connected to a paid booking) are kept for as long as the law requires. Server logs are kept by our host for a short period for security purposes and then deleted automatically.

Keeping it safe

The website is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), the contact form includes protection against automated abuse, and our email is protected by Microsoft's security measures. Access to enquiries is limited to the people at the café who need to see them. No system is completely secure, but we take reasonable care with what you send us.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to:

  • Ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
  • Have it corrected if it's wrong or incomplete.
  • Have it deleted, where we no longer need it.
  • Limit how we use it, or object to our using it, in certain circumstances.
  • Receive it in a portable format where we hold it electronically because you gave it to us.
  • Withdraw consent at any time, for anything that relies on it.

To exercise any of these, just email us at contact@riseandflour.co.uk and tell us what you'd like us to do. There's no form to fill in. We may ask you to confirm who you are before we act, and we'll respond within one month. There's no charge.

If you're unhappy with how we've handled your information, we'd like the chance to put it right — please tell us first. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), the UK's data protection regulator: ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint, or 0303 123 1113.

Children

Our website isn't aimed at children and we don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If you think a child has sent us personal information, email us and we'll delete it.

Changes to this notice

We'll update this page if the way we handle information changes — for instance if we add online booking or analytics. The date at the top shows when it was last revised.

Contact us

Questions about this notice or about your information: email contact@riseandflour.co.uk, call 01993 831 856, or write to Rise and Flour Ltd, The Elms, Shipton Road, Milton-under-Wychwood, Chipping Norton OX7 6JP.

pages.title: Terms of use
pages.content:
Last updated: 22 August 2026

These terms apply to the Rise & Flour website, riseandflour.co.uk. By using the site you agree to them. They're short, and they sit alongside our Privacy Policy, which explains how we look after any information you give us.

Who we are

The website is run by Rise and Flour Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales, trading as Rise & Flour, at The Elms, Shipton Road, Milton-under-Wychwood, Chipping Norton OX7 6JP. You can contact us at contact@riseandflour.co.uk or on 01993 831 856.

Using the site

You're welcome to browse the site, read about the café, check the menu and what's on, and get in touch. Please don't do anything that would damage the site or get in the way of other people using it — for example sending automated or bulk messages through the contact form, trying to gain access to parts of the site that aren't public, or introducing anything malicious. We may block access from anyone who does.

Menu, prices and opening hours

We do our best to keep the menu, prices and opening hours on the site accurate and current, but they can change — dishes come and go with the seasons, and we occasionally close for events or holidays. What's on the board at the café is what applies on the day. If a particular dish or time matters to your visit, give us a call first.

Dish descriptions list the main ingredients but not every one. If you have an allergy or intolerance, please tell us when you order or book and we'll advise you.

Events, bookings and private hire

Event listings and booking links on the site are an invitation to get in touch, not a confirmed booking. A place at an event, or a private-hire booking, is only confirmed once we've replied to you and said so. Nothing is sold or paid for through this website; any payment is arranged directly with us and the arrangements for it — including any deposit or cancellation terms — will be set out when we confirm. If an event has to be changed or cancelled, we'll contact everyone who has booked.

Contact form and messages

Messages sent through the contact form are emailed to us. We reply as soon as we can, usually within a day, but please don't rely on the form for anything urgent — phone us instead. Anything you send us is handled as described in our Privacy Policy.

Google Maps

The map on our Location page is provided by Google Maps. By using this website, and the map in particular, you agree to be bound by Google's Terms of Service (google.com/intl/en/policies/terms) and to Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy). Google may set cookies when the map loads; our Privacy Policy has more on this. If you'd rather not use Google Maps, our address and directions are written out on the same page.

Our content

The words, photographs, logo and design on this site belong to Rise and Flour Ltd or are used with permission. You can share links to our pages and quote us in reviews or articles. Please don't copy our photographs or logo for your own use without asking — email us; we're usually happy to help.

Other websites

Where we link to other websites — Google Maps, social media, event ticketing or partners — we don't control them and aren't responsible for what they contain or how they handle your information. Their own terms and privacy notices apply.

What we're responsible for

The site is provided as it is. We take reasonable care to keep it accurate and available, but we can't promise it will always be error-free or online, and we aren't liable for losses that arise from relying on information on the site that has since changed, or from the site being unavailable. Nothing in these terms limits our responsibility for anything the law doesn't allow us to limit — such as death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or fraud. Your statutory rights as a consumer aren't affected.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time — for example if we add online booking. The date at the top shows when they were last revised, and the version on the site is the one that applies.

The law that applies

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, and any dispute about them will be dealt with by the courts of England and Wales. If you live elsewhere in the UK you may also be able to bring a claim in your local courts.

Contact

Questions about these terms: contact@riseandflour.co.uk, 01993 831 856, or Rise and Flour Ltd, The Elms, Shipton Road, Milton-under-Wychwood, Chipping Norton OX7 6JP.

events.title: Sourdough Workshop
events.content:
A hands-on morning in the café kitchen. We start with a live sourdough starter, work through mixing, folding and shaping, and finish with a bake — you leave with a loaf, a pot of starter and the confidence to keep it going.

Coffee and pastries included. Suitable for complete beginners; aprons provided.
events.excerpt: Spend a morning with our bakers learning to mix, shape and bake a loaf to take home.

events.title: Easter Art Competition
events.content: Every spring the café walls fill with Easter drawings from local children. Entries were pinned up through the week and the winners picked on Easter Saturday, with prizes from the counter.
events.excerpt: Our annual children’s drawing competition — entries pinned up around the café all week, winners announced on Easter Saturday.

events.title: Supper Club No. 12
events.content:
One long table, eighteen chairs, five courses. We cook what the last warm weeks give us — tomatoes at their best, corn, plums, and herbs from the courtyard — and serve it family-style, the way we’d feed our own.

Doors at 7pm, first plates at 7.30. Bring a bottle if you like; we’ll have a short list of ours. The menu is fixed — tell us about allergies when you book and we’ll cook around them.
events.excerpt: One long table, eighteen chairs, five courses of late summer, served family-style.
